name: data-table
description: A source-owned, generic Data Table pattern with sorting, row selection, filtering, and pagination, composed over Table/Checkbox/DropdownMenu/Button/Input/Pagination.

documentation.compositionNote: A recipe, not a black-box widget, matching shadcn's own React pattern: consumer supplies Vec<DataTableColumn<T>> and Vec<T> per use. No headless table-state dependency exists in this ecosystem (task 9.1's audit), so sort/filter/select/paginate state is hand-rolled and source-owned rather than delegated to a primitive -- consistent with carousel.rs/resizable.rs. Composes the sibling registry items Table, Checkbox, Input, Pagination directly for its own chrome, and DropdownMenu via the optional DataTableRowActions helper for per-row actions.
documentation.accessibility: Reuses Table's semantic <table>/<thead>/<tbody> markup and Checkbox's own accessible state; sortable headers are real <button>s (keyboard-activatable); the row-actions trigger carries a screen-reader-only "Open menu" label (registry/ui/data_table.rs).
documentation.keyboard: Sortable column headers and pagination controls are native/Button-backed and Tab/Enter-operable; row-selection checkboxes and the row-actions DropdownMenu inherit their own primitives' existing keyboard support (Space to toggle, arrow-key roving focus in the menu).
